reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that models agent state from conversation and tool events, persists situation-based memory, and feeds reflective context back into the system prompt.

summaries.zh: 一个根据对话与工具事件建模智能体状态、持久化情境记忆并将反思上下文写入系统提示词的 DeepSeek Harness 插件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that models agent state from conversation and tool events, persists situation-based memories, and feeds reflective context into the system prompt.

capabilities: observes conversation and harness tool-result events
stores durable interaction-derived seeds and state
writes a self-model section into the agent system prompt
provides self_reflect, self_appraise, self_recall, and self_transform tools
